dog.description_text:
Since I'm a long stay pup, my adoption fee has been reduced! Visit me today to find out my favorite treats and how you can take me home!

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I'm ready to learn! I need a patient person who has the time to work on training with me.

I am excitable and energetic! I will need positive outlets for my energy!

I love to be loved, but on my own terms! Let's brush up on some canine body language together!

I would do best in a home with only adult humans.

My #BoroughBreak Buddy writes: Twinkle Toes is a social dog and professional sitter! She did not like that the day started with a few hours of rain, so we cuddled in a coffee shop with a pup cup until the sun came out. Twinkle knows basic commands like sit, down, no, but could brush up on her "leave it" skills when it comes to food dropped on the street. She loves to show you her sit and parade her bone around to people! Twinkle was good on leash, she did stare at dogs walking by and when one dog barked at her she did bark back, but nothing was difficult to manage as she was easily redirected. Twinkle is one of those dogs that are the best of both worlds in that she can keep up on a hike or just as easily couch potato with you, as long as she's with her people! She will make an excellent addition to any forever family.
dog.name: Twinkle Toes
